title: Inventory Profiles
description: Save and load full inventory layouts with commands or keybinds. Works in survival multiplayer.
body:
# Inventory Profiles

Save and load your full inventory layout — hotbar, main inventory, armor, and offhand — with one command or keybind. Perfect for **PvP kits**, **mining setups**, **building loadouts**, and swapping gear fast.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Save your entire inventory** — every slot, including empty ones
- **Full item data** — enchantments, custom names, and NBT preserved
- **Multiple named profiles** — PvP, mining, building, and more
- **Quick keybinds** — save/load your default profile instantly
- **Great for SMP servers** — quickly switch between PvP, mining, building, and other loadouts
- **Multiplayer support** — works on external servers in survival and creative
- **Client-side** — profiles are stored locally on your PC

---

## ⌨️ Commands

All commands are **client-side** (no OP required):

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/profile save <name>` | Save your current inventory as a profile |
| `/profile load <name>` | Load a saved profile |
| `/profile list` | List all saved profiles |
| `/profile delete <name>` | Delete a profile |

**Examples:**

- `/profile save pvp`
- `/profile load pvp`
- `/profile list`
- `/profile delete old`

---

## 🎮 Keybinds

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **K** | Save default profile |
| **L** | Load default profile |

Default profile name: `default`

Rebind in **Options → Controls → Inventory Profiles**

---

## 🔧 How it works

### Singleplayer / LAN host
Inventory is applied directly on the server.

### Multiplayer — Creative
Items are placed via creative sync packets.

### Multiplayer — Survival
The mod opens your inventory and rearranges items using click packets (similar to client-side sort mods).

No new items are spawned — only items already in your inventory are moved.

### Full inventory?
The mod uses hotbar swaps and the **2×2 crafting grid** as temporary storage while loading.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> In **survival on servers**, you can only rearrange items you already have. Missing items will **not** be spawned.

> [!TIP]
> Re-save your profiles after mod updates to keep enchantments and NBT stored correctly.

> [!NOTE]
> Keep your inventory open while a profile is loading on multiplayer survival. Other players do **not** need this mod installed.

---

## 💾 Where profiles are saved

- `.minecraft/config/inventory_profiles.json`

Profiles persist between game sessions.

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** `0.19.3+`
- **Fabric API**

---

*Switch loadouts in seconds. No more manual sorting.*
